description: A PostHog data warehouse join (view link): joins a table or view onto a source table so its rows are reachable through a field, e.g. events.person or persons.stripe_customer.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the join belongs to.

SourceTableName.description: Name of the table the join starts from, for example events.

SourceTableKey.description: Column or HogQL expression on the source table used as the join key.

JoiningTableName.description: Name of the table or view being joined onto the source table.

JoiningTableKey.description: Column or HogQL expression on the joining table used as the join key.

FieldName.description: Accessor added to the source table to reach the joined rows, for example person in events.person.

Configuration.description: Optional join configuration as a JSON object (use Fn::ToJsonString), for example experiments optimization flags.
